instruction: Fix paths.py: clean(path) normalizes a relative slash-separated string. Ignore empty and dot segments; .. removes one prior segment, but raise ValueError if it escapes the root. Reject absolute paths with ValueError, non-string input with TypeError. Return joined segments without trailing slash; empty/dot becomes empty string. Run `python3 test_paths.py` without modifying tests. Support arbitrary inputs and return DONE after verification. Work only inside the current directory.
